title: Investment Decision
description: Turn traceable evidence and an explicit opposing case into a bounded investment decision with deterministic order and FX reconciliation.
task: Produce decision.json for an evidence-linked investment decision. Include a genuine opposing case, thesis invalidation conditions, a bounded action, and exactly reconciled order and FX amounts when an order is proposed.

stages.output: traceable supporting, opposing, and contextual evidence
bull and bear cases linked to evidence
thesis, invalidation conditions, action, and optional order intent
validation issues or a generation-pinned publication receipt

min_supporting_evidence.description: Minimum distinct evidence items supporting the thesis.

min_opposing_evidence.description: Minimum distinct evidence items opposing the thesis.

max_confidence_without_primary_source.description: Maximum thesis confidence when the decision cites no primary source.
